snapshot.summary:
- Purpose: a demo back-office login page to authenticate users for the admin site.
- Main flow: enter credentials into the input fields and activate the "Login" control to authenticate and be redirected to the admin dashboard.
- Alternate/negative flows: failed login (wrong credentials), empty-field submission, and repeated attempts showing error messages.
- Navigation: post-login redirect to dashboard, possible return links or session-dependent pages.
- Input validation edge cases: very long strings, leading/trailing whitespace, unicode/emoji, special characters, SQL injection and XSS payloads.
- Security/behavior edge cases: account lockout or rate limiting on repeated failures, HTTPS/session cookie behavior, missing/invalid CSRF token handling.
- UX/accessibility edge cases: missing labels/placeholder text, keyboard-only navigation, autofill behavior, caps-lock warning, password visibility toggles.
- Resilience edge cases: slow or dropped network, disabled JavaScript, and unexpected server errors (5xx) or redirects.

snapshot.summary:
- Main purpose: Admin dashboard demo showing notifications, messages, tasks, alerts and navigation to admin pages (charts, tables, forms, UI elements) for managing/inspecting application data.
- Main user flows: navigate main menu (Dashboard, Charts, Tables, Forms, UI Elements), open message/task/alert summaries (Read All Messages, See All Tasks, See All Alerts), access user menu (User Profile, Settings, Logout), and drill into specific pages (Flot/Morris charts, panels, buttons, notifications).
- Key UI interactions to test: click navigation items, open/close message/task/alert lists, follow links to detailed pages, and use user profile menu actions.
- Data/visualization flows: rendering of chart pages, tables and forms, and state changes when marking tasks/messages/alerts.
- Important edge cases: empty lists or zero notifications, extremely long user/message/task text (truncation/wrapping), duplicate or missing element IDs, and special characters in names.
- Robustness/resilience: behavior with slow/no JS, slow network or timeouts, session expiration (logout), and broken links to detail pages.
- Accessibility/keyboard: keyboard navigation, focus order, and screen-reader labels for interactive items.

edges.description: Login functionality is critical to test and likely leads to the admin dashboard, a core area of the site
